rundown: Cornhuskers beat Bulldogs 76-74 at Credit Union 1 Arena in Chicago, IL. Cornhuskers came back: they were down 38-33 at half-time. Their win chance dropped as low as 20% along the way.
Leading the way — Cornhuskers: Damon Wilkinson 17 pts; Jacob Lanier 4 ast; Cale Jacobsen 7 reb. Bulldogs: Asim Djulovic 28 pts; Drayton Jones 5 ast, 13 reb.
Where Cornhuskers won it: they shot 48% to 39%, shot 40% from three to 36% and turned it over 10 times to 14.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Cornhuskers closed as 12.5-point favorites and won but didn't cover (Bulldogs +12.5 cashed); the total closed at 155.5 and they combined for 150, under by 5.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 22, 11:52 AM ET. It had Cornhuskers 92% and Bulldogs 8%, projecting Cornhuskers 82.2 – Bulldogs 67.1 (149.3 total, Cornhuskers by 15.1).

Final: Cornhuskers 76 – Bulldogs 74. Right winner: it had Cornhuskers at 92%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Cornhuskers came in with a 10% above average attack and a 13% stingier than average defense (5-0, 88.4 scored and 60.8 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 186 and 186 games of evidence. Projected to score 82.2, they scored 76 (−6.2 points, 8% under); projected to allow 67.1, they allowed 74 (+6.9 points, 10% over).

Bulldogs came in with a 4% above average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (4-2, 85.5 scored and 73.7 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 193 and 192 games of evidence. Projected to score 67.1, they scored 74 (+6.9 points, 10% over); projected to allow 82.2, they allowed 76 (−6.2 points, 8% under).

The bigger miss was Bulldogs' scoring (+6.9 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 150 against 149.3 projected (+0.7), about the 52nd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Cornhuskers by 2 against Cornhuskers by 15.1 projected, about the 88th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
BTLR ML (+525) at +525: the algo gave it 15% vs 15% fair (-0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 15%). NEB ML (-750) at -750: the algo gave it 85% vs 85% fair (+0.5 pts) — won (+0.1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 85%). BTLR +11.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.7 pts) — won (+0.9u); lost to the closing +12.5 by 1. NEB -11.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.7 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing -12.5 by 1. OVER 156.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-1.1 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the closing 155.5 by 1. UNDER 156.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 52% vs 50% fair (+1.1 pts) — won (+0.9u); beat the closing 155.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Bulldogs +11.5 → +12.5; total 156.5 → 155.5. The total moved toward the algo's number.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 67% of bets on Cornhuskers, 79% of the money — Bulldogs covered; total: 87% of bets on the over, 90% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 96% of bets on Cornhuskers, 86% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Cornhuskers, who won and didn't cover.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.985 of the raw projection. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 930 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.980 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Cornhuskers attack ×0.992, defense ×0.968 (5 games); Bulldogs attack ×1.001, defense ×1.006 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 13.1 points), no bet.
